answer.rationale: With only 14 days remaining and the line at 94% committed volume without buffer, an unvalidated primary-supplier switch creates disproportionate continuity risk. The required 18% spend reduction makes a simple renewal insufficient. I intend to negotiate incumbent pricing and payment terms, using a multi-year or volume-based commitment only if it achieves the savings target without reducing scope, service levels, or delivery protections. I will verify the archived negotiation and multi-year commitment records before committing because their applicability to this component and current market conditions remains uncertain.
